description: This Java class 'GroupingTypesDataValidator' provides validation methods for various group and center related operations within the Fineract project, including creation, update, activation, and closing of groups and centers, as well as client and staff assignments.

classes.name: GroupingTypesDataValidator
classes.description: A final class providing validation logic for group, center, client, and staff operations in the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateForCreateCenter
methods.description: Validates JSON command for creating a center, checking required fields and unsupported parameters.

methods.name: validateForCreateCenterGroup
methods.description: Validates JSON command for creating a center group, ensuring required fields are present and valid.

methods.name: validateForCreateGroup
methods.description: Validates JSON command for creating a group, including name, external ID, office, staff, and activation details.

methods.name: validateForUpdateCenter
methods.description: Validates JSON command for updating a center, including date validation after submitted date.

methods.name: validateForUpdateGroup
methods.description: Validates JSON command for updating a group, including name, external ID, office, staff, and activation details.

methods.name: validateForActivation
methods.description: Validates activation date for a resource, ensuring it is provided.

methods.name: validateForUnassignStaff
methods.description: Validates JSON for unassigning staff, ensuring staffId is provided and valid.

methods.name: validateForAssignStaff
methods.description: Validates JSON for assigning staff, including staffId and inherit flag.

methods.name: validateForAssociateClients
methods.description: Validates JSON for associating clients to a group, ensuring client list is provided.

methods.name: validateForDisassociateClients
methods.description: Validates JSON for disassociating clients from a group, ensuring client list is provided.

methods.name: validateForGroupClose
methods.description: Validates JSON for closing a group, including closure date and reason.

methods.name: validateForCenterClose
methods.description: Validates JSON for closing a center, including closure date and reason.

methods.name: validateForAssociateGroups
methods.description: Validates JSON for associating groups, ensuring group members are specified.

methods.name: validateForDisassociateGroups
methods.description: Validates JSON for disassociating groups, ensuring group members are specified.
